name: agent-inbox
description: One inbox for everything your AI agents are waiting on you for. A Cloudflare Worker + D1.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

BOT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token your bots send to create items and mark them done. At least 32 characters: generate one with openssl rand -hex 32. Store it in a mode-600 file for your agents; never paste it into chat.

INBOX_SECRET.description: Shared secret you type into the inbox page to unlock it. At least 32 characters: generate one with openssl rand -hex 32.

FORWARD_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. URL that receives every click (done, reject, reply, snooze) as JSON. Leave empty to skip forwarding.

FORWARD_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: Optional. Sent to the webhook as Authorization: Bearer <key>, for receivers that check a sender key.

FORWARD_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Optional. Signs each webhook body with HMAC-SHA256 in the X-Agent-Inbox-Signature header. Never sent; use a different value from FORWARD_WEBHOOK_KEY.

CANONICAL_BOTS.description: Optional. Comma-separated bot names to always store with exactly that spelling, e.g. Deploy Bot,QA. Leave empty to keep each bot's first-seen casing.
